summary: Iteration 2 full test of new features (departments/per-dept banners, SMTP config + email sending, click tracking + analytics). Backend: 40/40 pytest passing (21 regression + 19 new). Frontend e2e verified: admin login, department creation via input-new-department + button-add-department, dept tab appears, upload slides, set banner-link, generate GIF (data-testid=gif-slider-preview shows .gif url from /api/files/sigflow/brand/banner_{dept_id}.gif), default banner still works, per-department resolution correctly picks dept banner when employee.department matches (verified in live signature preview img src) and falls back to default gif_url when department cleared. SMTP config saves and masks password (has_password badge 'Configuré', password field blank on reload, from_name persists). Test-send returns 502 gracefully (fake SMTP -> HTTP 502 handled by backend + toast on frontend). Click tracking public GET /api/track/click?u=&b=&url= returns 302 to target; Analytics page shows total (12+), banner-stat-UITestBanner appears, button-refresh-analytics works. RBAC: newly-registered employee has only nav-employee-portal in sidebar; navigating to /app/gif|/app/email|/app/analytics|/app/employees|/app/brand all redirect to /app/signature.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/settings replaces the whole document via CompanySettings.model_dump(); any client omitting fields like department_banners/gif_url/gif_images will wipe them (Pydantic defaults are [] / ''). Frontend BrandAssets currently sends full settings so it works, but this is fragile — consider a partial-update model (Optional fields + $set only present keys) to prevent accidental loss of banners on future refactors.

server.py /api/track/click has u/b/url as untrusted query params; consider validating url is http(s) before RedirectResponse to prevent open-redirect abuse (e.g. javascript: or protocol-less). Currently only 'https://www.google.com' fallback is safe but arbitrary target URL is echoed to Location header.

server.py /api/email/send-all iterates all users sequentially; for large user counts consider asyncio.gather with concurrency limit + individual SMTP timeouts (currently 30s each -> could take minutes).
server.py store SMTP password in plaintext in Mongo. Not a blocker for MVP but should be encrypted-at-rest or kept in secret store.

Login inputs are input-auth-email / input-auth-password / input-auth-name / button-auth-submit / toggle-auth-mode.
